title: The Sandpipers "Guantanamera" 8-Track Tape A&M 8T-4117 - Columbia Stereo
descriptionText:
Up for sale is a vintage 8-Track tape of "Guantanamera" by The Sandpipers, released on A&M Records (8T-4117).

This cartridge comes in its original Columbia Stereo Tape Cartridge Service slipcover, showing expected wear from age and storage, including some surface wear, discoloration, and creasing. The 8-Track itself appears intact with original labels, which show some scuffs, small tears, and aging as pictured.

Track listing:

Program 1:
Guantanamera
Carmen
Cast Your Fate to the Wind
Program 2:
La Mer (Beyond the Sea)
Things We Said Today
What Makes You Dream Pretty Girl?
Program 3:
Louie, Louie
Strangers in the Night
La Bamba
Program 4:
Enamorado
Stasera Gli Angeli Non Volano (For the Last Time)
Angelica
Condition:

Tape: Untested, sold as-is for listening or display/collectible purposes.
Labels: Moderate wear with some peeling and small punctures visible (see photos).
Case: Columbia slipcover shows typical wear from age; great vintage patina.
Perfect for collectors of vintage music media, Sandpipers fans, or those looking to add to their retro 8-track collection.
